fact: On 12 October 2021 the Council of Ministers adopted two decrees, one creating the national steering committee of the SIPAO programme and one creating the Centre d'informations de police du Togo (CIPT) and the Fichier central national des données policières, a central police data file managed by the CIPT and common to justice, police, gendarmerie, water and forests and customs, under the personal data protection law of 30 October 2019.
title: Conseil des ministres du 12 octobre 2021 : deux projets de décrets adoptés et quatre communications écoutées
